notes.title: Balance & Beasts | Patch 1.15
notes.content:
After taking time to step back & look at the game as a whole, this update aims to give a better player experience alongside new content! This update offers a wider spectrum of difficulty, cleans up buggy interactions, balances the power curve for the player and enemies, and creates more opportunities for intriguing deckbuilding. I hope you enjoy!

This is a large patch, so here's a TL;DR:
- All Enemies Adjusted + New Enemies
- Many Action Changes (Buffs, Nerfs & Reworks)
- Focus Rework
- Base Game Difficulty decreased
- New Difficulty System (now "Heats")
- New Pathing System added, Map Generation Reworked
- HUD Rework + More QoL Settings
- New Content! (New Actions, Artifacts, Perks, Events)
- Many many bug fixes.

[h3]Difficulty Changes[/h3]
I aimed to lower the difficulty of the base game, which was done mainly through enemy nerfs and requiring less XP to level-up. For those who liked the tougher challenge, there is a new Heat System that allows players to have more control of the game's difficulty. Hopefully this gives a larger spectrum of gamers free Reign!

[h3]Enemy Reworks & New Enemies[/h3]
All enemies in the game were changed in one way or another. These were mostly nerfs and moveset changes, but also include a few complete reworks. With these changes, I hope the game feels like it challenges you at a better pace than before!

There are also 12 New Enemies, some with multiple forms.

[h3]Buff & Debuff Changes[/h3]
- Strength has been renamed "Power", and made more rare throughout the game.
- 3 new "Strength-like" Buffs: Brawn, Cunning, and Precision. Like Strength, each of these buffs add damage to each roll, but only for specific weapon types.
- New Buff: Crit - Chance to deal 1.5x more damage from Attacks.
- New Buff: Maxed - Next roll is guaranteed maxed.
- Shocked (Rework): When damage is dealt, 50% change to pass all shock. Take damage = Shock at turn end.
- Thorns no longer ticks down. Decreased Thorn availability for Enemies + Player.
- A few other new Buffs to encounter!

[h3]Pathing System & Map Generation Changes[/h3]
Now the map contains branching paths instead of being able to access every room at the end of a floor. The idea is to create more interesting decisions when picking your next room! The Map Generation rules have also been slightly tweaked.

[h3]Action Changes[/h3]
There are A LOT of changes! About 1 in every 3 Actions got changed somehow. The intent was to make more Actions pickable to try to boost build diversity.

[i]I attempted to make a complete list of all the Action Changes, but it turned out there were far too many, and constantly notating them interrupted my creative workflow.[/i]

[h4]Some High-Level Action Changes:[/h4]
- All Actions now are "queued" up and played one at a time. This fixes some strange and unintended interactions that were possible before.
- New Attribute: Crit - Chance for the Action to Critically Strike.
- New Attribute: Chosen - Effect triggers when Action is Chosen to be Discarded/Vanished/Smithed/etc.
- New X-Cost Actions: Use your remaining NRG to determine effects of Action.
- Stings & Arrows no longer appear in rewards.
- Many New Actions!

[h3]Focus Rework[/h3]
- Focus now increases all rolls on the next Attack or Defend Action, instead of only applying to the 1st roll
- Focus no longer applies to AOE Actions

[h3]Other Gameplay Changes[/h3]
- All Characters embark with 50 gold. (Draft Mode grants an additional 75g)
- Weapon Proficiencies are now available as a starting bonus after a set amount of runs.
- Alchemist Shops will now always contain at least 2 Potions that benefit from instant use (Health, Max Health, XP, Focus). One of these Potions will always be free!
- Goblin Shops will now always contain a Proficient Action, as long as you are proficient with a valid weapon type.
- Rogue: Instead of embarking with additional Gold, now draws +1 Action each turn.
- Berserker Class: While below 50%, gain 1 Energized & Agile at turn start
- Assassin Class: Now proficient with Scythes
- If you do not find an Artifact in a Chest, it boosts the odds that the next Chest will have an Artifact. This "boosted" chance is reset once an Artifact is found from a Chest.
- If you choose a ? room with less than 50 gold, the ? room cannot be a Shop.

[h3]QOL/Other Changes[/h3]
- New Settings:
	-  Damage Number: (Combined/Individual) - see the total damage dealt, or show each individual instance of damage as it's own number
	- Dice Resolving: (On Land / Delayed) - lets you choose whether you want the dice effect to resolve immediately upon a dice landing (how it used to be), or after a short delay.
	- Dice Roll #'s: (On / Off) - more clearly shows each dice's roll result.
- HUD elements have been adjusted to better account for Dice visibility.
- Purchased items in the market now can be enabled/disabled to appear in runs.
- Some new sound effects!
- Lots of visual fixes and code optimization!

[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
- There were many issues Drawing Actions with the quantity drawn, especially when there was a reshuffle involved. These should all be resolved! (Please let me know if you encounter anything weird!)
- Several issues with Actions being played in a specific order were resolved.
- Lots more... (Both THANK YOU + SORRY to those who've reported bugs!)

[h3]THANK YOU![/h3]
Thank you for continuing to support and play Reign of the Renegade! I am still having fun improving it even half a year after release. I am still invested in making this game the best it can be, so I am always eager and open to feedback. Let me know what you think of this patch on Discord or the Steam Forums!

The full list of (ongoing) patch notes, are available on the [url=steam://openurl_external/https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?u=https%3A%2F%2Fdiscord.gg%2FD6sHUyVbgA]Discord[/url]!

notes.title: Patch 1.13
notes.content:
A patch of fixes, along with a couple Action system changes, Settings for Borderless mode, & Automatic Crash Reports. Stay tuned! Other fun stuff is coming.

Action Systems Changes & Tooltip Readability Improvements:
- Some Actions have a static effect (eg: Inflict 1 Exposed), but based on how the Action tooltip used to read from top-to-bottom, the order in which effects would resolve were either inconsistent, or ambiguous. (this caused questions like: does it deal damage, THEN apply Exposed?)
- Now, Actions with these static effects (and others, such as Centered and Trinity), will trigger these effects when the Action is played. This change affects many different Action interactions, made some Actions stronger, and made some weaker, but ultimately made the effects more consistent.
- This hopefully should make understanding what an Action does easier!
- This change did involve me painstakingly going through all 300 Actions. I did my own QA but I apologize if there are any mistakes I missed. I'll correct as quickly as I can if they are found!

New Settings:
- New Setting allows for Automatic Crash Reports. If you enable this setting and the game crashes, relevant game information will be sent directly to me to help me fix it! Should have been a feature long ago, but I'm still new to this!
- (Experimental) Resolution & Borderless Settings added. I am still trying to figure out some issues with booting the game in Windowed/Borderless mode if you have multiple displays, but any window displacement should correct itself once you arrive at the main menu.

Balance:
- Fragile (Debuff) reverted - gain 50% > 25% less block
- Pre-shield (Warrior Perk) Buffed - gain 1 > 2 Block at turn start

Enemy Balance:
- Changed Golem Forms around. Ice Golem was replaced with a Poison Golem.
- Reworked Diearies

Fixes:
- Fixed Blocksmith perk giving an additional 5 Block when player has Sturdy
- Fixed an issue where sometimes an Artifact / Action would not register as discovered when it was already mastered
- Fixed a crash when upgrading specific Actions at turn end
- Fixed Golems not all appearing in Bestiary
- Altered Golem fight to not always contain one of each Golem
- Fixed dungeon mist not being destroyed when re-entering the menu. This affects performance after a while
- Fixed other code that affected game performance
- Fixed Repress rolling a d4 and giving Block (unintended)
- You can no longer grab Action Rewards when a Tutorial appears

Visual:
- Fixed d20's showing a result of 19 on the dice when rolling a 20
- Fixed enemy Buffs/Debuffs appearing over Settings
- Fixed a few other depth-related issues
- Removed Legacy art for upgraded Actions on Rewards screen
- Fixed some Action coloring inconsistencies
- Added a bit of visual polish to a few different elements

HOTFIXES:

1.13B: 
- Fixed Crashes related to Mystery Mead & Duplicating Actions

notes.title: Patch 1.12
notes.content:
A decently sized patch - Draft mode got some further tweaks to decrease difficulty, more bugs fixed, & more content! There's still a few more elusive bugs I have yet to get to - but every patch gets closer! I was working on quite a few different systems throughout this patch, and hope I didn't break anything unintentionally. I'll try to patch ASAP if anything big pops up!

Content:
- 13 New Actions (4 Per Character, 1 Special)
- 6 New Artifacts
- 1 New Buff: Sturdy - Retain Block
- 1 New Debuff: Bleed Out (plus, a rework to Bleed to give it slightly better scaling)
- 2 New Events

Draft Mode Changes:
- Guaranteed rare perks at level 4
- Combats drop an extra Action reward
- Dramatically increased potion drop rate in Draft

Action Balance:
Warrior:
- Sucker Punch++, Always costs 0, not-Innate > Innate
- Challenge++, 1d6 (1d8) you and enemy gain Attack
- Reforge ~ 1d8 Atk, Smith 1 (2) Actions
- Wield ~ 1d3 Draw Actions, gain 1 Strength for each Atk drawn
Rogue:
- Reposition ~ 1d6 Def, Draw 1 (2) Discard 1
- Provoke ~ Now inflicts Enraged
- Razor Wind-- 2d4 > 1d8 (also fixed bug where it deals infinite damage during [REDACTED])
- Tempest-- Now costs 4 (3) and is always Fleeting

Enemy Balance:
- Gelatinous Shape Reworked, no longer self-buffs
- [Redacted] Nerfed slightly
- Many enemies no longer innately retain block. Enemies can only retain block if they also have Sturdy.

Artifact Balance:
- Cauldron++ now drops a Potion in every combat Reward
- Scrambled++ now only transmutes Punches + Defends]
- Plush Pillow++ now also restores all Focus
- Energy Vial-- now removes 3 Potion Slots
- Slingshot ~ now gives 1 Strength and 3 Regen in Elite Combats
- Cursed Mail++, gives 2 Fortitude
- Arrythmic Flask ~ reworked to non-boss Artifact: When you use a potion, discount a random Action in hand by 1 NRG

QoL:
- Reworked Tutorial System -- I kept putting it off, but its was long overdue. It's still not quite perfect, but I think it's better than before!
- Added settings for enabling Character letter / Mastered Star on Action Tooltips

Fixes:
- Fixed Warrior Perk "Evanesce" not drawing Actions
- Fixed Recollection still ticking "Vanish" triggers even when Recollection saves the Action from Vanishing
- Whet now gains Proficiency bonus as well as it can gain extra dice from Oracles
- Fixed Vengeful sometimes triggering on damage
- You can no longer dodge your own Shock trigger
- Booze Bomb gives all enemies Exposed as intended
- Oracle in Act 4 shop now charges you discounted prices
- Enemies now aren't able to buff/buff all when Clumsy
- Two Hungry Perk now only draws 2 as intended
- Fixed 2 Perks (Rogue + Knight) where they weren't getting Evade / Counter when being Attacked by Atk+Debuff / Atk+Status
- Fixed certain enemies dropping Block unintentionally
- Fixed being able to use Recycler when game is paused
- Rush now appears in Library
- Fixed Discovered/Mastered total counts


Visual:
- Reworked Particle system in an attempt to fix memory leak
- Fixed Fog not clearing when revisiting the menu (maybe fixes some graphics related crashes?)
- Added setting for disabling Fog
- Reworded Monk Meter tooltip
- Reworded Bargaining Chip
- Added clarification for Drain ticking at turn end
- Added a couple new hit FX for different types of Actions
- Riggit Rum tooltip text shows 1d3 as intended
- Fix tooltip hover hitbox for enemy Buffs
- Reworded Helix Artifact


HOTFIX 1.12B: Fixed Bleed out applying to player when intended for enemy.
HOTFIX 1.12C: Fixed softlock when choosing to Smith an Action in combat.
HOTFIX 1.12D:
- Fixed crash when healing at end of game
 - Gold sprite fixed
- Fixed crash when concluding turn (couldn't replicate so apologies if something that I wasn't expecting was causing it)
- Indignation now only triggers below 50% hp
- Shop won't say "new" when you have everything unlocked
HOTFIX 1.12E:
- Fixed Maxed Rolls not working from Some addtl types of rolls (Stealth/Finisher/etc)
- Fixed Maxed Rolls not stacking (using multiple Max Potions in a row resets the # of rolls)
HOTFIX 1.12F:
- Removed an unintended Game Save Loop at room start. This should help older machines.
- Fixed a softlock & crash with Smithing Status/Curse Actions mid-combat
- Fixed Boost allowing you to Boost Actions with no Dice
HOTFIX 1.12G & H:
- Attempted to fix an on end turn crash in the G-patch, actually fixed it in the H-patch
HOTFIX 1.12I:
- Fixed crash when continuing a run after saving and exiting the game.
HOTFIX 1.12J:
- Bleed Out now affects HP instead of max HP.
- Reworked Angry Buff - Now gives Strength when it ticks to 0 instead of ending your turn
- Reworked [REDACTED] fight. Now the body has a new buff: Reactive
- Fixed Lyrus headstone
HOTFIX 1.12K:
- Fixed crash when loading an ancient run file
HOTFIX 1.12L:
- Fixed Buff Actions not proccing various effects. (Most notably, not counting their Weapon-type as being "played")
HOTFIX 1.12M:
- Fixed New Actions shipped with 1.12 not appearing. (Thanks to Hotfix 1.12D for Hot-breaking this)
- Fixed alternate enemy forms for Vampbats, Stingers, Ivee and Mushroom not appearing.

notes.title: Patch 1.1 - Balance & Content
notes.content:
A heftier patch that intended to make the difficulty curve more consistent, while also adding some new content!

[b]Content:[/b]
- 31 New Perks
- 10 Versatile (4 Common, 5 Uncommon, 1 Rare)
- 3 Per Character (1 Common, 1 Uncommon, 1 Rare)
- 1 Per Class (Uncommon)
- 3 New Artifacts (2 Common, 1 Rare)
- 2 New Buffs: Inspired & Aware
- 2 New ? Events
- Discord link on main menu (tell your friends)

[b]Gameplay Changes / Balance:[/b]
- Chests now contain more gold, and always contain a potion
- Thief is now also proficient with Feet
- Perks can now be bought in the Market! Some new Perks, as well as a few existing Perks were moved into the Market to be unlocked.
- Adjusted a few "punishing" ? Events to be more favorable
- Curses & Status Actions no longer count towards Discovery & Mastery

[b]Action Balance:[/b]
- Invincible (Event Action) Nerf - 2 (1) NRG > 3 (2) NRG
- Webs (Status Action) Nerf - Conclude now gives a static 1 Entangled
[i]Warrior Action Balance:[/i]
- Rush Nerf - Rush is no longer Innate, Rush+ gains Innate
- Sheathe Nerf - 1d6 (1d6+1d3) > 1d4 (1d8)
- Shed Armor Rework - Lose Block, Draw 2 (3)
[i]Rogue Action Balance:[/i]
- Ransack Buff - 1d4 (1d8) > 1d6 (1d10)
- Dagger Toss Buff - 2 > 1 NRG
- Gash Buff - 2 NRG 1d8 (1d12) > 2 NRG 1d10 (1 NRG 1d10)
- Lock On - Gives Inspired instead of Strength+Weak
[i]Monk Action Balance:[/i]
- Learn Buff - 1d3 > 1d4
- Channel Rework - Channel+ also gives Inspired
- Restless Buff - 1d6 (2d3) > 1d6 (2d4)
- Spirit Field Nerf - 2 NRG (1 NRG) > 3 NRG > (2 NRG)
 
[b]Perk Balance:[/b]
- Replaced "Less Debuff (Versatile) Perk [Gain 1 less Debuff]" with "Synchronize"
- Synchronize - When you gain a Debuff from an enemy, inflict it back
- Keen Eye buffed, now gives 3 Keen instead of only 1
- Trifecta (Monk) Rework - Trinity effects trigger twice (old effect was pretty niche)
- Sustain (Monk) Buffed - Gives more Max HP

[b]Buffs/Debuffs Balance:[/b]
- Asleep - Now also ticks down when damaged
- Bleed - Now deals 5 damage
- Confused - Now ticks down per Action randomized
- Lucky - Now persists in combat instead of ticking down
- Entangled - Now ticks down at turn start (this is a nerf to Entangled!)
- Fragile - gain 50% less block (used to be 25%)
- Thorns - Thorns can no longer be dodged by the player

[b]Artifact Balance:[/b]
- Tabloid of Truth - Now gives 10 Confused instead of 3
- Nancy's Goblet - Now gives 5 Inspired on turn 1

[b]Enemy Balance:[/b]
- Reworked Ivees
- Reworked Stingers
- Reworked Clops
- Reworked Durkar
- New Aware / Inspire Buffs added to a few Enemies
- Slightly tweaked a few others (minor HP + moveset tweaks)

[b]QOL/Other:[/b]
- Added crown icon to Classes you have won with on Class Selection screen
- Added additional design to upgraded Action tooltips

[b]Fixes:[/b]
- Monk Meter will now cap at 5 (previously, it would only visually show 5 stored, but you could have much more stored behind the scenes.)
- Weakspot Rogue Perk (+2 to Attacks in Stealth) now only applies +2 to Attacks as intended
- Fixed Papyrus Skeleton spawn chance, which also fixes...
- "The Professor" Achievement is now possible due to Papyrus spawn bug fix
- Fixed a bug that stopped Homebrew Event from appearing
- Fixed player being able to dodge most ? Events damage. There are still some where evasion will let you dodge!
- Fixed Absolute Chaos Event crashing the game on rolling an 18
- Cursed Locket now counts Curses that were already in your Bag prior to picking up
- Rolling Boulder event correctly gives XP
- Fixed Blind ticking into the negative
- Fixed Lyrus > Redacted fight retaining buffs


[b]Visual Fixes:[/b]
- A couple damage number tweaks/fixes
- Fixed a couple tooltip display rounding errors
- A few typos/phrasing fixes
- Curses no longer always appear in the Library
- Some grammar fixes in events lol
- Dice stop rolling when combat is finished

[b]Dev Notes:[/b]
With this bigger patch, I wanted to include an update on what's next for Reign of the Renegade. At the moment, the only concrete future plans are bug fixes and balancing, with a little content dripping here and there.

I'll continue to work on it whenever I get strokes of inspiration (as you can see from this patch, I was only trying to balance the game and got a bit carried away), but I also wanted to set an expectation that I can't promise new content on a consistent schedule. Hopefully then when content does get added, it'll feel fresh!

I love the project, and still see myself getting lost in it from time to time. However, after working on it for over a year, my brain is craving something new!


[b]HOTFIX 1.101:[/b]
Game will no longer freeze upon loading into a room with a ton of Artifacts
[b]HOTFIX 1.102:[/b]
- Reworked Artifact System. Now it allows for the player to have more Artifacts than the screen can hold
- Shop Refresh now works as intended in Act 4

notes.title: Hotfix 1.092
notes.content:
Addressing some quick bugs. I intend to do a bigger balance patch in the coming days, but wanted to make sure this one was pushed out ASAP!

Fixes:
- Smith Sauce no longer crashes the game
- Upgraded Draft Actions that lower NRG cost when upgraded now have correct NRG

Visual Fixes:
- Fixed Typos
- Fixed enemy d10 Attack Dice rendering strangely
- Grounded text wording now clarifies at turn start

notes.title: Hotfix 1.091
notes.content:
Hello-hello, I am still alive! I am only back for one day before I go on my HONEYMOON! Since my time was limited, I prioritized what seemed the most important (or what was easy enough to fix). This consisted of mostly bugs, but I also addressed some glaring Balance things. Thanks for sending those bug reports and feedback in-and also for being so patient!

Other:
- Changed the Programmer/Designer and the Emotional Support's last names in the credits because it was outdated. (WE GOT MARRIED!!!!!!!!!!!)
- Sorry to those that experienced crashes during my time away - I was really hoping to avoid those, but gamedev is hard!
- Added Discord link to Settings
- Added a "Delete Run" button that can be accessed by clicking on your Profile on the main menu. This is just a band-aid/emergency fix for if folks encounter something really weird and cannot proceed with their run.

Gameplay:
- Abandoning a run now cashes out your earned Essence

Balance:
- Praying now costs 1 NRG (just testing!)
- Practiced Perk Nerf - Now gives +2 to starter Actions instead of +3
- Barbs Upgrade Buff - Now rolls 2d4 instead of 2d3
- Smash, Stab, Uppercut, War Cry, Booze Bomb, Vault Rework (AKA 90% of all Actions that Inflict Exposed) - Now favor static amount of Debuffs
- Hold the Line Rework
- Prepared+ Nerf

Enemy Balance:
- Croc Buff
- Bossilisk & Rat King Buffs, Gelatinous Shape (Frozen Form) Rework
- Owlbear & Kobold Buffs
- Hobgoblin Buffs
- Cholder has more Attacking options
- [REDACTED] Heads Buffs

Fixes:
- Fixed allowing you to both Retry AND Leave with your rewards upon Death, causing a crash
- Fixed Oracle Site crash if you have no Oracle-able Actions
- Fixed Smith Sites softlock when you have no Smith-able Actions
- Fixed upgrading Actions in combat increasing NRG cost if reduced by another effect
- [REDACTED] fight now resets to turn 1
- Player Damage must now break through Enemies' Block in order to trigger their Buffer
- Enemy Counter no longer ticks down on their turn
- Grit now gives correct amount of Counter+Tough
- Dig now correctly lets you grab the result of the dice roll instead of only 1
- Heartlet now procs Feeding Spoon (oops)
- Phantasmal Block gained per Action no longer scales with Fortitude
- Drain now deals 6% max HP damage (my math was soo wrong on this, honestly embarrassing)
- Vigor - Monk Perk now gives 2 Strength on combat start
- Hoarder - Rogue Perk now gives correct amount of Strength

Visual Fixes:
- Finishing a fight with a "Pick X Actions to Vanish/Discard/etc." Action should no longer get the "Pick X" text stuck on screen
- Killing blows will automatically close Draw/Discard/Vanish UI
- Emberleaf "Campfire" typo

I'll be back in a week with more!

notes.title: Hotfix 1.09
notes.content:
OKAY! Last patch before I go AFK for a few weeks. No-one discover any game-breaking bugs, agreed?

Fixes:
- Fixed a crash if you happened to have a corrupt Run File
- Fixed Draft mode carrying your previous draft picks into the next run. Not sure how I missed this 2 days in a row - apologies!
- Fixed Rhythm (Rogue Ninja Perk) counting non-Atk actions
- SPEEDRUNNERS HATE HIM: Fixed skipping Boss Artifacts allowing you to skip the entire next Act (honestly one of the funnier bugs). Also moved the "Skip" button for Boss Artifacts to prevent double-clicking and skipping unintentionally.
- Made a system change to how the "Pick 1 Action to Vanish/Retain/Dupe/etc," system works. There was a fundamental problem with how these effects were triggering, allowing them to stack on top of each other, leading to a softlock. Now, they go in order of which they were queued.
- Fixed Buffs being completely stripped at the start of combat (sorry to any people who picked Booster or the Pray Perk, they were useless)

Balance:
- Bounty (Rogue Perk) gives more XP and max HP
- Flurry (Rogue Perk) now fills remaining hand space w/ stings on turns 1 AND 2

Visual Fixes:
- Actions: Accelerate & Barbs now shows Diceroll icon as intended
- Adjusted phrasing on Vlad's Angry Buff

As a note, I am fully aware that you are able to cheese the Draft mode to get unlimited free packs. Since I couldn't get to an elegant fix, consider this your present for playing through the holidays!

There are a few other things that were reported that I am aware of. Either I couldn't get to it, am planning a rework, or I couldn't replicate it. Think I got all the game-breakers though!

Time to relax. Happy holidays to all!

1.09B: Fixed a crash related to Drafting & new pick a card system

notes.title: Patch 1.08
notes.content:
Got more than I expected done today! Fixed some bugs and went down the balance rabbit hole a bit. I guess this one I'm calling a "Patch"? 

Fixes:
- Jester actually no longer freezes/sleeps you
- Fixed crash with Smith Sauce when having Curse/Status in hand. (I swear I tested this yesterday but...)
- I BELIEVE I fixed a crash with the Monk class (Fist/Feet) where it was erroring out trying to pull a proficient action (Notable from elites, since they have guaranteed proficient actions). Let me know if you get this again, I think it should be completely squashed.
- Sort of a Rework, but Shock was not passing as intended. Reworked how it works, and hopefully better worded it.

Balance:
- Calm Mind rework
- Fury Chop+ buff
- Slightly tweaked a few Act 2 and 3 enemies, hp nudges and moveset adjustments

Draft Mode-Specific Changes:
- Reduced the amount of Starter Punch/Defends you start with by 1
- FREE Packs off the bat
- Start the run with a Level-up!
- Slightly Lowered the XP needed per level
- Disabled Contract Boss Artifact

Visual Fixes:
- Actions in the shop should no longer appear over other things
- More, didn't write em down

notes.title: Hotfix 1.07
notes.content:
An assortment of stuff today! Chipping away before I go AFK for a while.

Balance - Some glaring things, some smaller things:
- Increased the minimum/maximum number of Shops per Act to 2/3, respectively. Shops used to be limited to only "good" floors (floors that only offer Smith/Rest/Shop/Oracle/Chest), but now a 3rd shop can spawn outside of these "good" floors
- Chest will always contain at least gold
- Padlock Artifact no longer locks chests, and instead of giving 0 XP, now gives 50% less XP
- Key Artifact was buffed from 30>50% more gold from Chests
- Slightly nerfed Electric Golem
- Jester can no longer Freeze you
- Nerfed Swift Strikes [3 swords in 1 turn perk]: Now only gives 1 NRG back instead of 2 (yeeeah it was a bit busted, but was fun while it lasted)
- Gave Spear a set amount of Wounded. Now all Wounded sources cannot be influenced by Focus/Proficiency
- Reworked Punish

QOL:
- Hovering the enemy's portrait in the timeline now shows their immunities. I have some ideas surrounding how this could evolve, but for now I kept it simple
- Added "Unmastered" filter to Action Library

Fixes:
- Circlet now procs in Act 4
- Study+ now gives buffs as intended (Unupgraded was fine)
- Curses now no longer show up on Smith screens, as well as they can no longer be Smithed in combat by use of the Smith Sauce.
- Fixed Forgetful vanishing itself instead of the next Action drawn
- Fixed 2 memory leaks (hopefully all gone?)
- You can no longer claim a potion reward while one is flying to your potion belt

Visual Fixes:
- Rogue overdraw Block Perk now properly shows that it gives 1 Block
- Fixed locked classes on menu drawing their class tooltip when hovered
- Tumble tooltip fixed to show diceroll icon
- Fixed more Perk Orb proccing issues
- Fixed a depth issue with proficiency tooltips


There's still a couple more bugs that I'm aware of, they didn't quite make the cut today!

notes.title: Hotfix 1.06
notes.content:
Smaller patch today, there was a fundamental problem with how Concluding your turn worked in tandem with dice resolving, and it took a bit to sort through all my spaghetti to fix.

I'm really trying to clean up any glaring issues by the end of this week, as I'll be away from my coding machine for the most part of the remainder of the year. Keep submitting those bug reports! If something sucks (except the Jester fight), let me know!

Fixes:
- Added a "waiting state" to Concluding your turn, to make sure that all dice have finished their resolving before you are allowed to end your turn. This fixes strange interactions such as: playing Sheathe and ending your turn before the dice can give you Entangled, which would then cause your Entangled to carry over into the next turn.
- Fixed Coolheaded to now let you Vanish actions as intended

Visual Fixes:
- Fixed a couple Perks that would visually proc more than intended
- Added some additional text tooltips to a few buttons (Skip/Proceed/Back) that are dynamic and hopefully communicate more clearly to the player
- Increased Attribute tags' hover hitbox (Setup/Vanish/Fleeting/etc.)

Keybind Support:
- M = Toggle Map
- D = Toggle Deck
- I only implemented the bare basics of this today, and didn't have time to fully QA test. Use at your own risk! It shouldn't cause any errors, but things may look funky.
- There is also no UI to customize these keybinds yet, that is something that will have to come along later down the road. I mainly just wanted these to be implemented to accommodate those playing on Steam Deck!

Balance:
- Market essence inflation yet again, you can blame Lyrus. Good news is-if you've already bought stuff, thank your old money, because you're grandfathered in!

1.06B:
- I discovered that I had accidentally deleted some ? Event's code while making patch 1.06, which caused some ? Event options to crash. Thank goodness for source control!

notes.title: Hotfix 1.05
notes.content:
I have gotten so much support over the weekend I am still flabbergasted! Still work to be done though!

Fixes:
- Transmuting Actions now removes them from the pool, so Transmuting multiple actions in a row will now offer different Actions for each Transmute.
- Fixed Contagion Debuff crashing the game while on the last remaining enemy
- Fixed crash with Smithotron (it had a chance of selecting to upgrade an Action with an Oracle equipped, which the game was NOT ready for!)
- D20 Event no longer can award "none" Proficiency
- Attempting to Smith an Action when you have all Smithed Actions no longer creates just the "Cancel" button
- No longer able to click on ? Event options through the pause menu
- Fixed AOE Multi-dice actions not dealing damage after a target has died

Visual Fixes:
- Bleed tooltip typo
- NRG tooltip now properly accounts for max NRG Artifacts when displaying your max NRG

Balance:
- Punish now inflicts a set amount of Wounded

notes.title: Hotfix 1.04
notes.content:
Now that the dust has settled from release, I took a stab at balancing some overtuned enemies. In addition, the bugs start coming and they don't stop coming. Hoping to squash them all sooner or later!


Enemy Balance:
- Poison Bossilisk slightly nerfed
- Piercer no longer Bleeds
- i Elite starts combat with less thorns (10 > 6)
- Knights start combat with less Counter (7 > 5)
- Jester can no longer roll sleep Debuff
- Removed 2x Knight 1x Keeper fight from Act 3 Easy encounter pool
- Lyrus now has a crown

Balance:
- Action Buffs: Provoke, Orb
- Action Reworks: Shed Armor
- Drained Debuff nerfed from 7% max HP > 6% max HP
- Slight Market price inflation (under the Renegade's orders, I don't make the rules)
- Slight odds changes to a few ? Events where the options didn't feel weighted evenly
- Slightly decreased odds of Chests being empty

Fixes:
- Fixed a softlock when not collecting your reward from a ? Event
- Fixed a few Boss Kill Achievements not being awarded properly (so sorry)
- D20 ? Event outcomes fixed/tweaked
- Fixed the awful reshuffle noise
- When all the Actions in hand already have Retain, the game will notice and take you out of the "Select Actions to retain" state

Visual Fixes:
- Monk meter tooltip will no longer always say 5/5
- Study+ Centered text fixed
- Smith Potion now states "for remainder of combat"
- Text fixes on some ? Event options
- Artifacts should no longer overlap Bag of Holding screens
- Renamed "Bloodshed" Perk to "Blood-geoner" because Bloodshed is already an Action name OOPS
- Renamed "Clear Oracle" Artifact to "Clear Glass" to avoid confusion with Oracles

There are still more elusive and niche bugs that I am aware of and working on!

notes.title: Hotfix 1.03
notes.content:
More bugs squashed! I would normally not push more than one patch in a day, but softlocks suck.

Fixes:
- Fixed softlock when trying to select an Action with an empty hand
- Fixed softlock in act 4 shop when out of rollable Artifacts
- You are no longer able to click rewards through the pause menu
- Confess no longer heals you, now stores NRG per status vanished as intended
- Shop-rerolls now work in the same shop you purchased the Golden Tooth Artifact in

Visual Fixes:
- If you have negative XP, your XP bar no longer animates

QOL:
- Added a "proc" animation to Perks so they should grow similar to Artifacts/Buffs/Debuffs when they trigger

notes.title: Hotfix 1.02
notes.content:
This small patch addresses a couple more elusive bugs that were harder to track down a fix for.

Fixes:
- Fixed a crash related to Doom & Gloom enemies
- Fixed a crash when being guaranteed a proficient Action from an elite fight*
- Fixed Lyrus fight putting you into combat with 0 Actions
- Merciless should now accurately double the damage dealt

[i]*I couldn't replicate this bug after my attempted fix. Please do let me know if its encountered again![/i]

notes.title: Hotfix: 1.01
notes.content:
A good-sized list of bugs were found within the first few hours, this patch addresses a good chunk of them!

There are a few more complex and niche bugs that are still being worked on, but this is all I had the time and energy to fix on release day!

[b]Fixes:[/b]
- Fixed Crash from Alt-Tabbing out / back in during door selection*
- Fixed softlock from rapid-clicking event rewards*
- Potions are no longer clickable through your Draw Pile screen
- Fingerless Gloves now correctly limits your hand to 7 Actions
- Helix now can only appear as an Act 1 Boss Artifact
- Fixed rewards not appearing after a victorious run
- Slime Splitter Achievement now triggers correctly
- Retrying fights now actually costs Essence
- Upheave now works with Boost

[i]*I couldn't replicate these bugs after my attempted fixes. Please do let me know if they are encountered again![/i]

[b]Visual Fixes:[/b]
- When Grabbing from your Draw or Discard pile, remaining # of actions to be grabbed text will now also account for your remaining hand space
- Fixed various tooltip depth overlaps (Bottles in shop being over stuff + more)
- Shock now has death text
